topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I poured my heart into this invention, night after night, tweaking and refining until I was certain it was groundbreaking. When I finally mustered the courage to file for a patent, I was hit with the worst kind of news—someone else had already patented it. It's like all the air was sucked out of the room. I did everything I could, researched, documented every step, but it wasn't enough. Now, I'm faced with the reality that my creation, my baby, is legally someone else's. I have to figure out a way forward, but the path looks bleak and obscured, and the stakes couldn't be higher.
